items.title: Deadline to file Widerspruch against Pflegegrad 2 decision
items.quote: Halten Sie die Entscheidung für falsch, legen Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids Widerspruch ein – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Pflegekasse bei der Beispiel Ersatzkasse.
items.computation: Letter dated Fri 2025-03-28, assumed posted that day. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X (as amended for 2025) a posted notice counts as delivered on the fourth day after posting: 2025-04-01 (Tuesday). Period of one month under § 187 Abs. 1 and § 188 Abs. 2 BGB (§ 26 SGB X) starts 2025-04-02 and ends 2025-05-01. 2025-05-01 is a public holiday (Tag der Arbeit), so under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X / § 193 BGB the period runs to the next working day, Friday 2025-05-02. The objection may also reach another domestic authority or social insurance carrier by then.

warnings: The deadline assumes the letter was posted on its date, 28.03.2025. If it was posted later, the deadline moves later. If you received it later, you can rely on the deemed-delivery rule, but filing earlier is safer.

The letter grants Pflegegrad 2 and rejects the requested Pflegegrad 3 (38.75 points). If you want to contest this, file the Widerspruch in writing before the deadline and ask for a copy of the Medical Service report.
